item.title: Temperature-stable high-κ oxides for miniaturized capacitors
item.description:
این پژوهش اکسیدهای high-κ پایدار در دما را برای خازن‌های مینیاتوری معرفی می‌کند که عملکرد الکتریکی را در دماهای بالا حفظ می‌کنند.
Nature Electronics | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Machine learning-guided design identified tungsten bronze oxides with Bi/Ge co-substitution, yielding a ceramic with high permittivity (~185), ultra-low loss (<0.0005), and near-zero temperature coefficient (≤±30 ppm/°C). Strong Ge–O bonds sustain polar displacements during thermal expansion. Prototype capacitors exceed commercial benchmarks, demonstrating how ML can navigate vast compositional spaces to discover temperature-stable, low-loss, high-κ dielectrics for miniaturized electronics.
🏷 high-κ oxides · capacitors · temperature stability · miniaturization · dielectrics

💡 This work introduces electrostatic regulation of sulfur spatial evolution via BN/CNT heterostructures, separating polar and conductive domains to control polysulfide interactions. The design achieves 1150 mAh g⁻¹ over 500 cycles, establishing a new principle for dimensionally stable Li–S batteries beyond adsorption-centric strategies.

💡 The novelty lies in coupling oxygen-deficient In₂O₃₋ₓ catalytic sites with metallic In via a Schottky barrier, lowering electron-injection barrier potential. item.title: Spatially Selective Substitution Enabled [001]‐Oriented Li 1.2 Ni 0.2 Mn 0.6 O 2 Cathodes With Coupled Regulation of Li + Transport and Oxygen Stability
item.description:
این مقاله با دوپینگ انتخابی Mo6+ و Sr2+، کاتدهای غنی از لیتیوم Li1.2Ni0.2Mn0.6O2 با جهت‌گیری [001] و بهبود همزمان انتقال Li+ و پایداری اکسیژن را ارائه می‌دهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers selective Mo6+/Sr2+ doping to tune facet energetics, enabling [001]-oriented quasi-single-crystal Li-rich cathodes. The spatially differentiated dopants couple enhanced Li+ transport with suppressed oxygen release, reducing lattice strain by 47.2% and boosting 5C capacity from 133.6 to 163.1 mAh g−1. This dual-regulation strategy significantly advances high-energy, stable Li-rich battery cathodes.
🏷 lithium-rich cathode · Li1.2Ni0.2Mn0.6O2 · facet engineering · oxygen stability · Li+ transport
